system.text:
He Who Sits Astride the Howling Black Beast learns to howl like a Great Wolf. He may deliver a potent and terrifying war cry from the back of his charging mount. The Cry adds +2D to Intimidation when mounted and bearing down on your prey. Intimidation requires two actions. Also using the Cry, the Orc may call his wolf to him over great distances—communicating with him as if he himself were a wolf.

Type: Dt (die trait). Unpriced: costs 1 pt as a lifepath trait.

Restrictions: Orc lifepath trait

Source: Burning Wheel Gold Revised, p. 320
